records.text: Josh Hammer was sharing what many conservatives were sharing the day before about the horrific murder of Irina Zarutska
records.speaker: Yashar Ali

appearances.snippet: But Josh was just sharing what many conservatives were sharing and stating the day before. That's because they were talking about the horrific murder of Irina Zarutska

verification.notes: Yashar Ali did publicly state that Hammer was sharing what many conservatives were sharing about Iryna Zarutska, and Zarutska's killing was a major conservative-media topic after the September 5 video release. A new federal charge was also announced on September 9, the day of Hammer's post. However, Hammer's terse repost did not identify Zarutska, so the asserted motive remains an inference rather than a confirmed fact.

records.text: Yashar Ali is paid to do PR for Zionists on the right and on the left
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Yashar Ali, who, like I said, is quite literally paid to do PR for Zionists. I know this personally, on the right and on the left

verification.notes: Owens presents personal knowledge as the basis for alleging that Yashar Ali is paid to do PR for Zionists on both the right and left. Live searches found Ali's public commentary and reporting on the dispute, but no contract, payment record, client disclosure, named payer, or reliable investigation substantiating this financial accusation. It cannot be resolved from public evidence.
